name: textfilters
description: Textfilters monorepo for independently versioned TypeScript text filtering packages.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @textfilters/core && npm run build --workspace @textfilters/url && npm run build --workspace @textfilters/email && npm run build --workspace @textfilters/phone && npm run build --workspace @textfilters/profanity && npm run build --workspace @textfilters/spam
scripts.check: npm run check:metadata && npm run check:release-paths && npm run check:workspaces
scripts.check:workspaces: npm run check --workspace @textfilters/core && npm run check --workspace @textfilters/url && npm run check --workspace @textfilters/email && npm run check --workspace @textfilters/phone && npm run check --workspace @textfilters/profanity && npm run check --workspace @textfilters/spam
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @textfilters/core && npm run lint --workspace @textfilters/url && npm run lint --workspace @textfilters/email && npm run lint --workspace @textfilters/phone && npm run lint --workspace @textfilters/profanity && npm run lint --workspace @textfilters/spam
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm run pack:dry-run --workspace @textfilters/core && npm run pack:dry-run --workspace @textfilters/url && npm run pack:dry-run --workspace @textfilters/email && npm run pack:dry-run --workspace @textfilters/phone && npm run pack:dry-run --workspace @textfilters/profanity && npm run pack:dry-run --workspace @textfilters/spam
scripts.smoke:dist: npm run smoke:dist --workspace @textfilters/core && npm run smoke:dist --workspace @textfilters/url && npm run smoke:dist --workspace @textfilters/email && npm run smoke:dist --workspace @textfilters/phone && npm run smoke:dist --workspace @textfilters/profanity && npm run smoke:dist --workspace @textfilters/spam
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @textfilters/core && npm run test --workspace @textfilters/url && npm run test --workspace @textfilters/email && npm run test --workspace @textfilters/phone && npm run test --workspace @textfilters/profanity && npm run test --workspace @textfilters/spam
